title: Assistant Professor of Public Policy
bio: Luis is an Assistant Professor of Public Policy at the Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University. He graduated from Stanford University in 2022 with a Ph.D. in Economics. In the past, he has worked at Chegg and Microsoft Research and served as a research advisor at Meta. Before graduate school, he worked as an RA at the New York Federal Reserve. For the 2022-23 academic year, he was a post-doctoral fellow at the NBER.
research_interests: and Jesse M. Shapiro. "What is Newsworthy? Theory and Evidence." May 21
